Shanghai Municipal Council.
August 11th 191^
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
I therefore please to all have General mini-
self by Chinese some works are to Kiyosun & Co No.33
Minzhong Road. The metal is at present stored in that
Company's godown and will be shipped to Japan later on.
Several ex-soldiers who until recently were in
the pay of rebel leaders and who are without means, are
anxious to join one of the parties of Chinese workers,
who are being sent to Europe but they have no money
to take them to a port where they can enlist for
such employment.
A rebel officer named Hsui Li Ngen 許新源 who obtained
$500.00 from Sun Y.t S^n to give to his followers
has absconded with the money.
A memorial service in honour of Van Ting
Hsien 范鴻仙 an Anhui Revolutionary who was murdered
here on 20th September 1914 was held yesterday
in Zao Yin Garden Connaught Road. There were about
110 persons present including Dr. Tang Voon 譚人鳳
formerly Director of Hankow and Canton Railway
Yen Yu Zai 于右任 formerly editor of Min Li Pao 民立報
Hsu Hsui 韓恢 a leading rebel, Woo Han Ming 胡漢民
O ^ ^ Tung Bo 龍振 Li A Tien 劉天民 leading
rebel military officers of Anhui.
nearly all the above named persons made speeches
eulogising the character of deceased. They spoke
of the harsh way in which Yüi Sr Tsung (袁世凱)
present Tit h of Anhui and O'ang Hsun treated
the revolutionaries. They advocated the removal of
these officials. They also complained about the action
of the Shanghai Municipal Council saying that they
had intended to hold the memorial service in Chang Su
Ho's temple this morning but the Council declined
to give their permission. Some of the speakers went
so far as to say that it was hard that Chinese could
not hold a memorial service in their own country.
The service which started at 3.30 p.m. and
finished at 4.45 p.m. was more in the nature of a
political meeting than a gathering to honour a dead
comrade.

上海工部局。
191^年8月11日
（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））
警务处，
（侦探股。）

先生，
因此，我谨报告，有些中国工人受雇于民忠路33号清松公司（Kiyosun & Co.）。金属目前储存在该公司的仓库中，稍后将运往日本。
几名前士兵，他们直到最近还由反叛领袖供养，如今身无分文，急于加入那些将被派往欧洲的中国工人队伍，但他们没有钱前往可以登记受雇此类工作的港口。
一名名为许新源（Hsui Li Ngen）的反叛军官，从孙逸仙（Sun Y.t S^n）处获得500美元以分发给其追随者，却携款潜逃。
昨日在康纳特路（Connaught Road）的兆丰花园（Zao Yin Garden）举行了一场纪念仪式，以悼念安徽革命党人范鸿仙（Van Ting Hsien），他于1914年9月20日在此遇害。约有110人出席，包括曾任汉口及广东铁路总监的谭人凤博士（Dr. Tang Voon）、曾任《民立报》编辑的于右任（Yen Yu Zai）、主要反叛分子韩恢（Hsu Hsui）、胡汉民（Woo Han Ming）、龙振（O ^ ^ Tung Bo）以及刘天民（Li A Tien），后者均为安徽的主要反叛军事军官。
上述几乎所有人士均发表演讲，颂扬逝者的品格。他们谈及袁世凯（Yüi Sr Tsung）、现任安徽督军以及张勋（O'ang Hsun）对待革命党人的残酷手段。他们主张罢免这些官员。他们还抱怨上海工部局的行动，称他们原计划今天上午在张苏河（Chang Su Ho）庙举行纪念仪式，但工部局拒绝批准。一些发言者甚至表示，中国人在自己国家无法举行纪念仪式，实乃憾事。
该仪式于下午3时30分开始，下午4时45分结束，其性质更像是一次政治集会，而非单纯的悼念亡故同志的聚会。
